title: benchmark-lab: add representative workload runners, kernel-selection profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline v122
author: Maya Thompson
commit_summary: 3 commits: add representative workload runners and test harness; add kernel-selection profiling baselines and metrics collection; add reporting pipeline orchestration, alerting queries, and dashboard templates
commits: feat(bench): add representative workload runners and YAML configs for runner matrix
feat(profiling): add kernel-selection baseline harness and collection hooks (KV cache, seq-len buckets)
chore(reporting): add pipeline DAG, backfill job, and grafana dashboard templates; update docs and quickstart
description: Motivation: The benchmark-lab needs representative workload runners and updated profiling baselines for kernel-selection to improve model/kernel mapping and reduce perf regressions. This PR introduces a matrix of representative workload runners (interactive chat, long-sequence summarization, streaming few-shot generation, embedding batches), a kernel-selection profiling harness that records sequence-length buckets, KV cache hit stats, and selected kernel fingerprints, and a reporting pipeline v122 that ingests new profiling artifacts, computes baseline summaries, and backfills last 90 days of derived metrics. Changes include test harnesses, CI integration, dashboard templates, and documentation updates. Checklist: - [x] Add representative runners and YAML configs - [x] Implement profiling baseline collection + exporter - [x] Add reporting DAG and backfill job - [x] Add Grafana/Looker templates and alert queries - [x] Add unit/integration tests and CI jobs - [x] Update docs/quickstart Migration notes: New runner configs live under benchmark-lab/runners/v122. Reporting pipeline introduces a new table `bench.kernel_selection_baselines_v122` in the telemetry dataset; backfill job will populate it on merge. If you operate dedicated benchmarking infra, please schedule the backfill during low-traffic windows (recommended window: 02:00-05:00 UTC). Testing: Local runner smoke tests and CI matrix exercises representative scenarios; profiling harness unit tests included. Related: ENG-4212 (kernel-selection improvements), ENG-4389 (reporting pipeline v2).

Jonas Muller: CI matrix failed on first run due to missing dependency in runner_image Dockerfile. Author response: fixed Dockerfile and re-ran CI; all bench-matrix jobs passed.
